===Items===
There is also a selection of items that can be bought from [[Pirate Jackie the Fruit]] in return for [[Brimhaven voucher|Brimhaven vouchers]]. 

The graceful recolour costs 250 Brimhaven vouchers to recolour the full uncoloured graceful outfit. [[Pirate Jackie the Fruit]] will not recognise graceful pieces that have already been upgraded to a different style as valid pieces of graceful to recolour.
